caseName: General Tire & Rubber Co. v. Watkins
caseNameFull: General Tire & Rubber Co. v. Watkins, U. S. District Judge
attorneys: Norman P. Ramsey and Charles J. Merriam for petitioner., Edward S. Irons, William Wade Beckett, Mary Helen Sears and Stanley M. Clark for Firestone Tire and Rubber Co. et al., as amici curiae, in opposition.

opinions.text: The motion of Firestone Tire and Rubber Co. et al. for leave to file a brief, as amici curiae, is granted. Petition for writ of certiorari to the United States Court of Appeals for the Fourth Circuit denied.
